# Ordex

> Portable Bitcoin orders, verified before you act. Ordex is a non-custodial
> evidence and discovery layer for signed PSBT orders: it composes and
> verifies Bitcoin transactions, and it never signs, never holds or
> contributes funds, and never broadcasts on its own initiative.

Amounts are atomic integers carried as decimal strings, never floating point.
Paging is keyset, never offset. A public ask can be completed by anyone
holding the signed artifact, so it is never described as reserved.

## Contract

- [The gateway API, explained](spec/api.md): every route under /api/ordex and
  why it is shaped that way.
- [openapi.json](spec/openapi.json): the OpenAPI 3.1 contract, field by field.
- [sdk/README.md](sdk/README.md): the typed TypeScript client generated from
  that contract.
- [Completing a public ask](spec/purchase.md): the two rules and the sat flow
  invariant that decide whether the asset reaches the buyer.
- [Order lifecycle](spec/lifecycle.md): every reachable state and what a
  customer may do in each.
- [Portable orders](spec/interoperability.md): how an order enters and
  leaves a gateway, and the exact OpenOrdex kind 802 event contract.

## Conformance

- [conformance/purchase-vectors.json](conformance/purchase-vectors.json): the
  verdict a compatible verifier must reach for each named transaction shape.
- [verifier/purchase.js](verifier/purchase.js): a dependency free reference
  verifier implementing the purchase rules, run by `npm test`.
